terrain:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ORIGINAL transparent RGBA 1024 x 1536 portrait environment sprite atlas, a scrolling region for chapter 5 of an anime aerial shooter. This is NOT a full opaque space background.
Input images: Image 1 (green island) is ONLY the approved soft hand-painted anime style, integrated facilities, small physical scale and high overhead viewpoint reference. Do NOT copy its water, grass, trees, island layout or antennas. Image 2 (asteroids and wreckage) establishes the existing SPACE / ASTEROID / ORBITAL OUTPOST theme only; improve it, do NOT copy the close-up scale, polygonal 3D surfaces or aircraft wreck.
Primary request: several SMALL irregular asteroid islands with compact pearl-gray orbital maintenance structures genuinely mounted on their rock surfaces. Viewed from far ABOVE with a near-overhead orthographic bird's-eye view around 80 degrees downward from the horizon; mostly tops, with short visible rock side faces and a little building side wall, not an isometric diorama. Match the approved island reference's broad soft painterly strokes, clean midtone material separation and gentle ambient occlusion. These are distant environmental objects below the combat flight plane.
Composition: a 1024 x 1536 vertical coordinate field containing 3–4 differently sized separated asteroid clusters in an asymmetric staggered layout. Asteroids are about 140–270 pixels wide, NOT huge wall strips. Small building roofs are about 30–60 pixels wide, solar-panel arrays 40–70 pixels, other vents/conduits smaller. Central x=34%..66% is mostly transparent and quiet for readable combat; individual small rocks may approach the edges of that corridor, never fill it. Overall alpha footprint about 25–35% of this canvas. Large natural transparent gaps between distinct clusters. No continuous rectangular wall at either edge. Keep the top and bottom 4% fully transparent to allow quiet overlap; do not add a border or separator stripe.
Subject details: irregular slate blue-gray asteroids with broad layered hand-painted rock surfaces, a few impact pits and restrained fractures, subtle warm ivory upper-right highlights and cool lower-left shadows. Not repeated hexagonal stones. Compact white-gray industrial station modules with dull navy/steel roof panels, muted ochre docking markings and only a few tiny amber service lamps. Attached foundations, bolted supports, short local walkways and pipes must visibly touch the host rock. Local truss arms can extend a SHORT distance from their rooted base. No unsupported pasted-on structures, no shadows cast into empty vacuum, no giant city facade, no buildings taller than their asteroid. Between clusters only a FEW tiny natural stones, not a particle shower.
Lighting: upper RIGHT directional soft sunlight, lower LEFT cast shadows only on the same rock or deck. Painterly anime background finish, no heavy black outlines, plastic render, overly shiny metal, muddy photo texture or external glow.
Transparency constraints: genuinely TRANSPARENT background everywhere outside the solid asteroids/station parts, including gaps between clusters. No black/navy backdrop, no starfield, nebula, clouds, smoke, haze, gradients, ground plane, floor shadow, checkerboard pattern, vignette or opaque halo baked into the image. Keep dark actual rock crevices opaque.
Other constraints: no aircraft (intact or wrecked), flying spacecraft, enemies, people, bullets, lasers, UI, text, logos or watermark. No giant enclosing canyon and no full-width bridge. Objects must remain clear at mobile-game scale.
Layout A — maintenance outposts: upper-left a slightly crescent-shaped asteroid with two offset small low roof workshops and a compact attached solar rack. Mid-right a wider broken rock island with one small service hut, a SHORT L-shaped docking platform anchored to two rock brackets and two distinct recessed ore pits. Lower-left a smaller bare asteroid with a tiny sensor mast and one container. Keep each whole island silhouette readable and different, not identical circular boulders.

background:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ORIGINAL opaque 1024 x 1536 portrait seamless vertical distant starfield texture for an anime aerial shooter.
Input images: Image 1 is ONLY the existing chapter's dark blue / violet space palette and quiet central composition reference. Image 2 is ONLY the approved softly hand-painted anime background texture reference, not the island, buildings or sea subject.
Primary request: a very distant deep-indigo starfield with subtle painterly blue-violet nebula wisps gathered mostly at the far left and right and scattered very faint gas mottling. Quiet clean dark navy central 55%, never flat pure black. Sparse tiny low-contrast pin stars only, mostly single pixels to two pixels; no big glowing dots that resemble projectiles. Broad delicate hand-painted color transitions with soft depth, not a noisy photographic astronomy image, no dense glitter and no hard outlines.
Lighting/palette: dark desaturated midnight navy, muted indigo and smoky violet. Keep nebula luminance low behind pale aircraft, projectiles and environmental sprites. No bright white gas, neon, orange fire or lens flare.
Vertical loop: top and bottom edges share the same dark navy values and sparse faint texture; no horizontal bands, boundary line, gradient vignette or frame.
Constraints: ONLY starfield and distant nebula. No planet, horizon, sun, moon, asteroid, station, building, ship, aircraft, character, grid, text, UI, logo or watermark. Full opaque image, no transparency, no checkerboard.
transparencyEdit: Edit ONLY the transparency mask and remove the atmospheric halo from this original asteroid atlas. Preserve the exact object positions, sizes, colors, lighting, painting, station details and all three rock island silhouettes. Outside the solid rocks and station structures, set the background completely TRANSPARENT with alpha zero, including every gray, blue, warm or white glow, haze, gradient, floor shadow and cloud. No gray soft gradient around islands. Keep only a clean narrow one-pixel anti-aliased cutout edge. Inside all actual rock and metal surfaces use fully opaque alpha. Gaps between rocks and beneath bridge structures must be transparent. Do not add a background, checkerboard, new object or shadow. Final PNG RGBA 1024 x 1536 with genuine transparency.

integration.clouds: Three chapter 1 cloud geometry/motion layers, tinted low-opacity nebula. Far cloud behind asteroids, middle and near in front.
